title: TestSIGTERMToALiveRunEvacuatesItsWorkToTheRemote fails at base: the SIGTERM exit leaves a ticfac-registry-guard temp tree behind
body: Running the test alone, with or without GIT_CONFIG isolation, at base cd41beb2 and with this tick's changes, it fails identically: 'the SIGTERM exit left its temp trees behind: [ticfac-registry-guard-<random>]'. The child's registry-guard temp tree under its TMPDIR is not cleaned up on the SIGTERM evacuation path, so every non-short full-suite run (make test) is red on this host. The per-tick gate is unaffected: internal/cli passes under -short.
